hero.caption: Official ceremony on May 20th 2022, prior to the burial of Accomarca massacre victims, perpetrated by the Peruvian Army in August 1985, in Ayacucho region against disarmed civilians, Quechua-speaking peasants.

images.filename: Cortejo fúnebre en Accomarca (Ayacucho) de los familiares que llevan los restos de las víctimas de la matanza cometida por el Ejército en agosto de 1985.jpg
images.caption: On May 20th 2022, hundreds of relatives of Accomarca massacre victims -perpetrated by the Peruvian Army in August 1985, in Ayacucho region- arrived to the district, coming from several cities where they displaced during the time of violence (1980-2000). They received identified remains of some victims for a 36 years delayed burial.
images.alt: On May 20th 2022, hundreds of relatives of Accomarca massacre victims -perpetrated by the Peruvian Army in August 1985, in Ayacucho region- arrived to the district, coming from several cities where they displaced during the time of violence (1980-2000). They received identified remains of some victims for a 36 years delayed burial.
